findings.title: Delete action is never shown in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: canDelete is now computed from the Grafana Prometheus rule when rulerRule is absent, but the Delete menu item is additionally gated on `rulerRule &&`. The new GrafanaRuleListItem/RuleActionsButtons path passes only promRule and no rulerRule, so Delete never renders in the alert list view even for users with delete permission, despite the new prom-based ability returning allowed.

findings.title: Pause action is never shown in the ruler-less list view
findings.body: canPause is now computed from the Grafana Prometheus rule when rulerRule is absent, but the pause item is additionally gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`. Since the list view no longer loads ruler rules, rulerRule is undefined there, the type guard is false, and Pause/Unpause can never be rendered from the list view even when the prom-based ability allows it.

findings.title: Silence drawer cannot open for Prometheus-only rules
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu can now show Silence based on the Prometheus rule and sets showSilenceDrawer, but this component only renders SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer when `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule)` is true. In the ruler-less list view `rule` is undefined, so clicking Silence notifications does nothing and users cannot silence Grafana rules from the list.

findings.title: Grafana rule list items are rendered without a React key
findings.body: The 'grafana' case returns <GrafanaRuleListItem> without `key={key}`, unlike the datasource and unknown cases. FilterView builds a stable artificial key (getGrafanaRuleKey) specifically to prevent key duplication/reconciliation problems in this mapped list; omitting it causes React key warnings and can reuse the wrong row state when rules are added, removed, or reordered during pagination/filtering.

findings.title: Federated rule groups are no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously computed `isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group)` and used it to mark Update/Delete/Pause as unsupported. The refactored useAllRulerRuleAbilities hardcodes `isFederated = false` with a TODO, and useAllAlertRuleAbilities delegates to it. CombinedRule consumers (e.g. the existing rules table/details) can now offer edit/delete/pause for federated Mimir rule groups that must remain immutable.
